_notes.sampling: 30 fps source, stride 3 frames -> 10 Hz. History = 6 samples at t-0.5 ... t (0.5 s from first to last sample); future = 15 samples at t+0.1 ... t+1.5. Approved for P5.3 (supersedes the kickoff's provisional H = 5).
_notes.anchor_grid: Anchors are frames with frame % anchor_stride_frames == anchor_phase_frames (one global grid shared by all agents, so every window's sampled frames are multiples of 3 and per-frame graphs are shared, not duplicated, across target pedestrians).
_notes.timestamp_tolerance_s: Absolute tolerance for checking timestamp == frame / source_fps and sampling interval == 1 / target_sampling_hz.
_notes.target_source_mode: PILOT_SMOKE = perceived Phase 3/4 tracks provide both history and future pseudo-targets (pipeline validation only, not ground truth). ANNOTATED_TARGET is documented as a future extension and is refused by the implementation.
_notes.missing_observation_policy: TARGET_STRICT_CONTEXT_MASKED: the target pedestrian must have an observed node with a valid position at all 6 history and all 15 future sampled frames, otherwise the candidate is rejected with a reason code. Context agents are present at a history frame only if Task 3 has a node there; absence is an explicit False presence mask, never a filled value.
_notes.track_continuity_policy: No interpolation, no forward-fill, no stationary assumption, no merging of track identities; Task 3 track_index is the identity.
_notes.context_node_types: Default model context: pedestrian and vehicle. Bicyclist nodes come from the COCO 'bicycle' detection class (Phase 3 label 'bike'); a detection is not evidence of a rider, so they are retained in storage, flagged semantically uncertain, and excluded from the default context. They are never mandatory for a window.
_notes.pilot_split_label: One video, one scene group: no independent train/validation/test split is created.
